name: audio-player
title: Audio player
description: A player for voice notes, call recordings and AI voice replies: a 48 px pill for message threads, or a card with the recording's name, source and date. Click or drag the waveform to seek and the played part fills in as it plays; the card adds 10 s skips, elapsed and remaining times, a 1× / 1.5× / 2× chip and an optional transcript row. Loading and error swap the play button's glyph and dim the controls, with Retry. It plays a real file from src, or runs on a timer for previews.
author: UI Stacks <https://uistacks.dev>
